description: Shows the person three looks with the video's own cover headline on each, in one card, with colours to try under the one they choose, "From a reference" and "See all". Nothing is rendered and nothing costs credits. Give the three looks you'd pick for this video, best fit first. The groups, for your bearings: Bold type; Diagrams and maps; Clean product; Drawn and characters; Illustrated.
